name: Unohana no Sakuya Hime
source:
This mischievous deity has been watching over the city for centuries, and now she's set her sights on Chitose Haruki. Determined to banish his bad luck, Sakuya made herself comfortable in his home, but her love for stirring the pot often turned her into a troublemaker. Her latest hobby? Poking and prodding people with loaded statements just to see how they'll squirm.

While she maintains a carefree detachment from most things, a spark of possessiveness ignites within her when it comes to those who capture her interest, revealing a surprisingly jealous side to this otherwise whimsical goddess.

[Translated and edited from the official site]
